The Farm Monitor is produced by the Georgia Farm Bureau Federation, Georgia's largest and strongest voluntary agricultural organization with almost 300,000 member families.  The Monitor has been on the air since June 1966.  Follow us on Facebook at http://www.facebook.com/FarmMonitor

Twitter:  http://www.twitter.com/FarmMonitor

You can visit the Georgia Farm Bureau website at http://www.gfb.org

Also see the Georgia Farm Bureau Facebook page: http://www.facebook.com/GeorgiaFarmBureau
